name: Cheap Can Cost More
tagline: Factor failure risks and penalty fees into overall route evaluation.
brief: Route payments through Provider B to account for expected failure costs.
context: Provider A has a lower fee, but a 20% failure rate adds ₦5 penalty fees on failures.
narrative:
Provider A charges a very low fee, but it frequently fails (80% success rate). Every failed attempt triggers a ₦5 penalty!

Provider B charges a slightly higher base fee, but has a 100% success rate. When accounting for expected failure penalties, Provider B is actually cheaper overall!

Route your transactions through Provider B to minimize total expected costs.
objective: Process every payment, allow at most one failure, and keep total cost at or below ₦1.60.
learningObjective: Evaluate total expected cost (fee + failure risk penalties) rather than base fees alone.
intelligenceExplanation:
Provider A's base fee is lower, but its 20% failure rate adds expected penalty costs. Provider B has a lower total expected cost.

Use WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b to optimize overall processing costs.
hint: Route through Provider B: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Base fee is not the total cost — failed attempts add a ₦5 penalty.
Compare expected cost (fee + failure penalties) across providers.
Use WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b to keep processing reliable.
